test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

These parcels will be delivered later.

options.text: Somebody will be delivered with these parcels later.
Somebody will deliver these parcels later.
Later, these parcels will deliver somebody.
These parcels will deliver somebody later

solution:
The correct answer is **"Somebody will deliver these parcels later."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in passive voice and needs to be converted to active voice.
 
• In active voice, the subject performs the action expressed by the verb.
 
• The correct active voice for **"These parcels will be delivered later" **is **"Somebody will deliver these parcels later."**
 
• Option 2 correctly changes the focus from the parcels (the receiver of the action) to an unspecified person (the doer of the action).
 
• It preserves the future tense and the meaning of the original sentence without introducing any additional elements.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 ("Somebody will be delivered with these parcels later.") is incorrect because it suggests that somebody is being delivered with the parcels, which alters the original meaning.
 
• Option 3 ("Later, these parcels will deliver somebody.") incorrectly suggests that the parcels are doing the action of delivering someone, which is nonsensical.
 
• Option 4 ("These parcels will deliver somebody later") makes the same mistake as option 3, incorrectly assigning the action of delivering to the parcels rather than a person or delivery service.
